hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: interior Western Africa, southwest of Algeria, north of Guinea, Cote d'Ivoire, and Burkina Faso, west of Niger || mostly flat to rolling northern plains covered by sand; savanna in south, rugged hills in northeast || landlocked; divided into three natural zones: the southern, cultivated Sudanese; the central, semiarid Sahelian; and the northern, arid Saharan || Resources: gold, phosphates, kaolin, salt, limestone, uranium, gypsum, granite, hydropower || Exports: gold, cotton, oil seeds, fertilizers, gum resins (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly flat to rolling northern plains covered by sand; savanna in south, rugged hills in northeast || interior Western Africa, southwest of Algeria, north of Guinea, Cote d'Ivoire, and Burkina Faso, west of Niger

climate.excerpt: subtropical to arid; hot and dry (February to June); rainy, humid, and mild (June to November); cool and dry (November to February) || hot, dust-laden harmattan haze common during dry seasons; recurring droughts; occasional Niger River flooding

economy.excerpt: low-income Saharan economy; recession due to COVID-19 and political instability; extreme poverty; environmentally fragile; high public debt; agricultural and gold exporter; terrorism and warfare are common || Exports: gold, cotton, oil seeds, fertilizers, gum resins (2023) || Industries: food processing; construction; phosphate and gold mining
